caveats: Five of ten businesses in this batch are closed or unverifiable: Aap Carpet, Carpet & Futon Gallery, A & M Discount Vacuum and Smart Phone Doctor are all marked permanently closed on Google, and Prince Brothers Custom Tailoring has no Google listing at all. Only Grooming Tails, View A Miracle, Galis Photography, Gleason Funeral Home and Farrington Inn are live prospects.

Batch addresses are stale for at least three live businesses: View A Miracle now operates in East Brunswick and Edgewater, Galis Photography shows Jackson on its site and Freehold on Google, and Grooming Tails' Google address differs from the batch. North Brunswick directory data appears to be several years old.
Google Maps served us a limited view, so review counts were often hidden even where ratings showed. Where a count is quoted it comes from a named third-party source.
Review quotes are paraphrased in a few words only; no review text is reproduced.
data_gaps: gleasonfuneralhome.com returned a Cloudflare 'you have been blocked / sorry, you are blocked' page to our Chrome on every attempt, and the same block hit a plain fetch. Its layout, forms and mobile behaviour could not be reviewed; its robots.txt and sitemaps were readable and are permissive.
galispv.com serves an invalid TLS certificate (ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID); we had to override certificate checks in the browser to read the pages, and its robots.txt could not be fetched at all.
A & M Discount Vacuum's own domain now resolves to a Wix 'Reconnect Your Domain' placeholder, so nothing on their site could be read.
Review counts were not exposed for View A Miracle (4.9), Galis (4.1) or Grooming Tails (4.0) in the Google Maps view we received; Grooming Tails' count (6) comes from groomerjob.com.
No Google Business Profile could be found for Prince Brothers Custom Tailoring after two searches, so closure is an inference, not a confirmed status.
No online booking or scheduling platform (Booksy, Fresha, Vagaro or similar) was found for Grooming Tails; the salon appears to be phone-only.
